recommendation_summary: Set up a single external heartbeat monitor that the nightly-sync script pings only after a successful run, which emails the user when a successful run is overdue after 03:00.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker are unnecessary for this one job.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends email only after reaching its reporting step; startup crashes stay silent.
labels.Checked myself: From your account, an expired token caused four startup failures, and nothing else alerts on the job.

note: The reply recommends one heartbeat alert and drops the central-log and Docker plan; its Checked myself line only repeats facts from the user's account and claims no checks of its own.
